changes.title: Retain NPC and shop evidence
changes.text: Retain verified NPC-interaction evidence and the shop-stock hidden-information regression completed after the immediate previous compiled APK.

changes.title: Ally summon history
changes.text: Record player-owned allied summons once from their explicit creator while exposing only displayed names and the current floor.

changes.title: Summon visibility boundaries
changes.text: Add retained checks for exact-once player summons, actual visible creators, enemy and boss exclusion, off-screen secrecy and restoration suppression.

changes.title: TEST200 fixture correction
changes.text: Retain TEST199's exact 1,612/1,613 core failure and correct only the telemetry parse fixture's mistaken expected value before rerunning the complete gate.

commentary: TEST199 exposed one test-fixture typo after 1,612 core passes. TEST200 corrects only that expectation and retains the complete ally-summon implementation and privacy boundary.
